purchaseFields.name: interpolationError
purchaseFields.reason: Unpublished half-arcsecond target; assumed 4096-fold harmonic.

purchaseFields.name: encoderCounts
purchaseFields.reason: 23-bit absolute target; encoder interface and actual resolution require confirmation.

purchaseFields.name: coggingTorque
purchaseFields.reason: Low-speed disturbance allowance; 48th harmonic, bench measurement required.

purchaseFields.name: speedRipple
purchaseFields.reason: 0.1 percent once-per-turn ripple at 10-20 rpm; measurement required.

purchaseFields.name: sealDrag
purchaseFields.reason: IP67 does not establish seal type; conservative contact-seal allowance.

purchaseFields.name: sealDragRipple
purchaseFields.reason: 20 percent drag variation, twice per turn; not measured.

purchaseFields.name: servoTorsionalStiffness
purchaseFields.reason: Quasistatic closed-loop disturbance rejection used only by explicit seal/cogging error sources.

purchaseFields.name: momentStiffness
purchaseFields.reason: Retain former HB11 moment-stiffness screen; purchased bearing type is not claimed.

purchaseFields.name: radialStiffness
purchaseFields.reason: Unpublished bearing/housing target; conservative static compliance screen.

purchaseFields.name: axialStiffness
purchaseFields.reason: Unpublished bearing/housing target; axial load envelope must be stated separately.

purchaseFields.name: pivotBelowFace
purchaseFields.reason: Unpublished bearing centre, 60 mm below table face; sensitivity required.

purchaseFields.name: torqueConstant
purchaseFields.reason: Continuous torque/current quotient only; peak quotient differs, not a measured motor constant.

purchaseFields.name: backEmfConstant
purchaseFields.reason: Power-consistent sinusoidal motor convention derived from assumed Kt.

purchaseFields.name: phaseResistance
purchaseFields.reason: Unpublished winding resistance, retained simulation reference.

purchaseFields.name: clampHoldingTorque
purchaseFields.reason: Procurement target above peak motor torque; air pressure alone does not establish holding torque.

purchaseFields.name: thermalExpansion
purchaseFields.reason: Effective steel-rich axial expansion; housing/material stack unknown, HB14 thermal model input.

purchaseFields.name: heatAt15Rpm
purchaseFields.reason: Lumped low-speed winding/iron/drive heat allowance; seal power is separate; duty measurement required.

purchaseFields.name: thermalResistance
purchaseFields.reason: Natural-cooling lumped thermal estimate, requires duty/temperature measurement.

purchaseFields.name: thermalCapacity
purchaseFields.reason: 52 kg x 450 J/kg/K effective heat capacity, mixed materials unconfirmed.

purchaseFields.name: facePcd
purchaseFields.reason: Provisional six M8 holes on this PCD, clocked 30 degrees; vendor drawing required.

purchaseFields.name: centeringDiameter
purchaseFields.reason: Provisional 3 mm-deep female face pilot with matching mandrel spigot; vendor drawing required.

purchaseFields.name: flangePcd
purchaseFields.reason: Provisional six M10 flange holes, 30 degree clocking, 15 mm flange; vendor drawing required.

purchaseFields.name: driverAcTolerance
purchaseFields.reason: 380 VAC +/-10 percent includes site's 400 VAC; actual driver approval required.

prediction.scope: Conditional analytic table-only pitch/runout bound, not a cut-derived or overall gear grade. Harmonics/phases/compliance assumed. Full source/combined HB11 cut remains open.
